description.en: Neon blocks rain down faster and faster. Drag to dodge and see how long you can last. Buy the Chomp boost and a fatal hit turns you into a block-eating Chomper instead. Grab stars and stack shields, and push from Bronze at 15 seconds all the way to Legend. A goal bar always shows your next medal. Spend stars in the Shop on upgrades, skins and boosts, and clear rotating missions to rank up. Plays in landscape and portrait, with new art, music and sound effects.
description.zh-TW: 霓虹方塊越落越快，看你能撐多久！拖曳閃避，買了大胃王道具，致命一擊時會變身大胃王，把方塊通通吃掉。收集星星與護盾，15 秒拿銅杯，一路挑戰到傳奇杯，進度條隨時顯示下一座獎杯目標。用星星在商店購買升級、造型與道具，完成輪替任務提升等級。支援橫向與直向，全新美術、音樂與音效。

instructions.en: Drag anywhere to move left and right (arrow keys or A / D work too; on phones you can turn on tilt control). A quick on-screen guide shows the controls on your first run. With the Chomp boost, a fatal hit turns you into Chomp mode for a few seconds instead (every block you eat is a star). Collect stars to spend in the Shop, and pick up shields: each one absorbs a hit, and the Shield Stack upgrade lets you carry more. Keep moving: stand still too long and a block comes for you (watch for the red warning). Watch the goal bar for your next medal. A 3-2-1 countdown warns you before each speed rush. Survive the speed rushes and hold on through Overdrive. Landscape and portrait both supported.
instructions.zh-TW: 在畫面任意處拖曳左右移動（也可用方向鍵或 A / D；手機可開啟陀螺儀操作）。第一次遊玩會有簡短的畫面操作教學。帶著大胃王道具時，致命一擊會改為變身大胃王（幾秒內吃掉的每個方塊都換成星星）。收集星星到商店消費，拾取護盾可抵擋一次撞擊，升級「護盾堆疊」可同時持有更多護盾。別停在原地太久，否則會有方塊瞄準你落下（注意紅色警示）。留意進度條上的下一座獎杯目標。每次加速前都有 3、2、1 倒數提醒。撐過一波波加速，挑戰極速模式。支援橫向與直向。

controls.en:
- Drag left or right with the mouse or your finger to move
- Arrow keys or A / D to move
- On phones, tilt control can be turned on in the game
- Space or Enter to play again after a run
